message.content:
Extract the following information from the handbook PDF at /app/data/handbook.pdf:

1. PREHEAT definition and temperature region (e.g., 25°C to X°C)
2. Maximum ramp rate during preheat phase and the calculation method
3. TAL (Time Above Liquidus) measurement and threshold temperature
4. TAL window (minimum and maximum time limits)
5. Peak temperature requirements (minimum peak temperature)
6. Board geometry specifications and thermal dwell requirements for conveyor speed calculation
7. Allowable conveyor speed ranges or calculation method

Please search thoroughly through the document and provide exact values and definitions. If values vary by solder type, list them clearly. Do not estimate or guess values.
